result_text:
The four broken default conventions now match their intended files, and the new regression test passes along with the existing `SourceFileFilterTest`.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **`.htm` pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `(htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`.
- **`.NET` docs XML:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by`:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** the path pattern is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The old `/[.]js`-style patterns could only match a file named exactly `.js`, because path patterns must match the whole path. The content patterns are unchanged.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that `.htm` pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator pages are generated, that `.html` and `.xhtml` still match, that hand-written `.htm` pages stay out, that `MyAssembly.xml` with a `<doc>` line is generated, that `app.js` with `// Generated by` is generated while a plain `app.js` is not, and that `build-gradle.js` and `build.gradle` are build files while `app.js` is not. I did not run it against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there.

Nothing was committed.
